description.la: Dialogus de grammatico, quo modo «grammaticus» sit substantia et qualitas: quaestio de nominibus denominativis et de significatione. Textus ex editione Migne (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853).
description.en-US: Anselm’s early dialogue between teacher and student on how a word like “grammarian” signifies, being at once a substance and a quality: a work of logic and semantics. Latin only, from the Migne text (Patrologia Latina 158, 1853), a machine-corrected OCR, with the chapter summaries.
description.pt-BR: O diálogo de juventude de Anselmo entre mestre e discípulo sobre como um termo como «gramático» significa, sendo ao mesmo tempo substância e qualidade: obra de lógica e de semântica.

sources.edition: S. Anselmi Cantuariensis archiepiscopi opera omnia, ed. J.-P. Migne, Patrologia Latina 158 (Paris 1853), the Gerberon text; TEI XML of the Corpus Corporum (University of Zurich), text 10617, from the Open Greek and Latin machine-corrected OCR.
sources.description: The complete text with its chapter divisions and PL chapter summaries. PL page breaks, the column numbers and the apparatus of alternative chapter numbers (al.) are dropped; Scripture references stay in parentheses as printed. The OCR carries a few residual slips.
sources.tierEvidence: Anselm died in 1109; Migne’s 1853 printing is public domain everywhere.
